    getgenv().TeleportUI:Destroy()
end

toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -25)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 25, 45) -- Rimuru Deep Blue
toggleBtn.Image = RIMURU_IMAGE_ID
toggleBtn.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
toggleBtn.Active = true
toggleBtn.Visible = false
toggleBtn.Parent = screenGui

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

local toggleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
toggleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 195, 255)
toggleStroke.Thickness = 2
toggleStroke.Parent = toggleBtn

-- Dragging Logic for Floating Button
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
local function updateDrag(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

toggleBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = toggleBtn.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

toggleBtn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        updateDrag(input)
    end
end)

local function createFlake()
    if not mainFrame.Visible then return end

    local flake = Instance.new("Frame")
    local size = math.random(2, 5)
    local startX = math.random(0, 100) / 100
    local driftX = (math.random(-20, 20) / 100)

    flake.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
    flake.Position = UDim2.new(startX, 0, -0.05, 0)
    flake.BackgroundColor3 = (math.random(1, 3) == 1) and Color3.fromRGB(180, 235, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    flake.BackgroundTransparency = math.random(2, 5) / 10
    flake.BorderSizePixel = 0
    flake.ZIndex = 2
    flake.Parent = snowContainer

    local flakeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    flakeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    flakeCorner.Parent = flake

    local fallTime = math.random(35, 60) / 10
    local endPosition = UDim2.new(math.clamp(startX + driftX, 0, 1), 0, 1.05, 0)

    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(fallTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
    local moveTween = TweenService:Create(flake, tweenInfo, {
        Position = endPosition,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1
    })

    moveTween:Play()
    moveTween.Completed:Connect(function()
        flake:Destroy()
    end)
end

local isAnimating = false

local function hideMainUI()
    if isAnimating then return end
    isAnimating = true

    local shrinkInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
    local shrinkTween = TweenService:Create(mainFrame, shrinkInfo, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    })
    shrinkTween:Play()

    shrinkTween.Completed:Connect(function()
        mainFrame.Visible = false
        
        toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        toggleBtn.Visible = true

        local popInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        local popTween = TweenService:Create(toggleBtn, popInfo, {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
        })
        popTween:Play()
        popTween.Completed:Connect(function()
            isAnimating = false
        end)
    end)
end

local function showMainUI()
    if isAnimating or dragging then return end
    isAnimating = true

    local shrinkBtnInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
    local shrinkBtnTween = TweenService:Create(toggleBtn, shrinkBtnInfo, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    })
    shrinkBtnTween:Play()

    shrinkBtnTween.Completed:Connect(function()
        toggleBtn.Visible = false

        mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.3, 0)
        mainFrame.Visible = true

        local expandInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        local expandTween = TweenService:Create(mainFrame, expandInfo, {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 480, 0, 300),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -240, 0.25, 0)
        })
        expandTween:Play()
        expandTween.Completed:Connect(function()
            isAnimating = false
        end)
    end)
end

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(hideMainUI)

----------------------------------------------------
-- ANTI-CHEAT BYPASS TELEPORT LOGIC
----------------------------------------------------
getgenv().TeleportSavedCFrame = getgenv().TeleportSavedCFrame or nil
getgenv().TeleportLoopActive = false

local STEP_DISTANCE = 50
local LOOP_INTERVAL = 0.05

local function getHRP()
    local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

saveRow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if hrp then
        getgenv().TeleportSavedCFrame = hrp.CFrame
        saveText.Text = "Position Saved! (" .. math.floor(hrp.Position.X) .. ", " .. math.floor(hrp.Position.Y) .. ", " .. math.floor(hrp.Position.Z) .. ")"
        saveDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
    end
end)

local function performSafeTeleport()
    local targetCFrame = getgenv().TeleportSavedCFrame
    if not targetCFrame then return false end
    
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return false end

    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

    local currentPos = hrp.Position
    local targetPos = targetCFrame.Position
    local distance = (targetPos - currentPos).Magnitude

    if distance > STEP_DISTANCE then
        local steps = math.ceil(distance / STEP_DISTANCE)
        for i = 1, steps do
            if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then break end
            local alpha = i / steps
            hrp.CFrame = currentPos:Lerp(targetPos, alpha) * targetCFrame.Rotation
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait()
        end
    else
        hrp.CFrame = targetCFrame
    end

    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    return true
end

tpOnceRow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not performSafeTeleport() then
        tpOnceText.Text = "Save Position First!"
        task.wait(1.5)
        tpOnceText.Text = "Teleport Once (Instant)"
    end
end)

loopRow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not getgenv().TeleportSavedCFrame then
        loopText.Text = "Save Position First!"
        task.wait(1.5)
        loopText.Text = "Loop Teleport: OFF"
        return
    end

    getgenv().TeleportLoopActive = not getgenv().TeleportLoopActive

    if getgenv().TeleportLoopActive then
        loopText.Text = "Loop Teleport: ACTIVE"
        loopDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 230, 150)
        
        task.spawn(function()
            while getgenv().TeleportLoopActive do
                performSafeTeleport()
                task.wait(LOOP_INTERVAL)
            end
        end)
    else
        loopText.Text = "Loop Teleport: OFF"
        loopDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 90, 90)
    end
end)

    loadStatus.Text = "<< Notice: Analyzing " .. player.DisplayName .. "... >>"
    barFill:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 1, 0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 3.0, true)

    loadStatus.Text = "<< Executing: Slime Body Reinforcement >>"
    barFill:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 1, 0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 4.0, true)
    task.wait(4.0)

    loadStatus.Text = "<< Skill Acquired: Spatial Motion >>"
    barFill:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 1, 0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 4.0, true)
    task.wait(4.0)

    loadStatus.Text = "<< Welcome Lord Rimuru, " .. player.Name .. " >>"
    barFill:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1.0, 0, 1, 0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 4.0, true)
    task.wait(4.0)

    -- Fade Out Transition
    local fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    TweenService:Create(loadingFrame, fadeInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(loadBgImg, fadeInfo, {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(loadDarkOverlay, fadeInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(avatarImg, fadeInfo, {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(avatarStroke, fadeInfo, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(nameLabel, fadeInfo, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(loadStatus, fadeInfo, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(barBg, fadeInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(barFill, fadeInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()

    task.wait(0.5)
    loadingFrame:Destroy()

    -- Open Main UI with animation after loading
    mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.3, 0)
    mainFrame.Visible = true
    
    TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 480, 0, 300),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -240, 0.25, 0)
    }):Play()
end)
